known_quirks: Four daily endpoints are published at 0900, 1130, 1200, and 1700 MYT.
The endpoint returns full history back to 1997.
The 1130 dataset historically has fewer currency columns and mostly buying-rate records.
Consumers must tolerate absent and null currency fields.
